lado_card.texto: What repeats in every business is the method: documented, packaged and improved with every campaign.

rodape: INEMA.CLUB · open and free content · INEMA Learning v7.2 format · inema.club · Full course page on INEMA.CLUB · Guide: how to learn artificial intelligence

inicio.kicker: Course · 7 lessons · management with agents and method
inicio.titulo: If the next AI wipes out your work, you were polishing the tool
inicio.lead: Stop selling automation. Start selling method. In seven hands-on lessons, you put agents between you and your team, build an assistant that only acts with your confirmation, organize agents by function, and package your lead-generation method so you can repeat it in any business.
inicio.capa_alt: Dark work desk with an open method notebook and a blurred screen in the background.
inicio.aulas_sub: From management that runs on its own to a method you repeat. Each lesson has a diagram, a template to copy, practice with a "done when" and a commented test.

itens: Small business owners who have become the filter for every request from the team.
Consultants and agencies who sell automation and feel the price dropping.
People who already use AI agents and want to organize their work.
A contract for your first agent, with what it handles and what it never does.
A map of your agent team and the written rules for each one.
Your lead-generation method documented, with the ad and landing page at the same angle.
A plan for sensitive data before you plug AI into the client.
